objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: tori of 13 periodic plane tilings (square, triangular, honeycomb; kagome, 4.8.8, 3.12.12, 3.4.6.4, 4.6.12 by medial and truncation; their five Laves duals), built from tori of the three regular lattices of every shape, as networks of equally spaced rule-60 rings with law (12,12) contacts: which contacts persist, whether exactly those with a flip (an automorphism fixing the contact and exchanging its rings), which tilings keep every contact persistent, and whether their tori read distance plainly; hypotheses frozen in the contract.
title: Which contacts of periodic plane tilings persist: a census
